description: The figure presents two pie charts comparing the distribution of four outcome categories for a task or evaluation setting, with each chart divided into 4 slices labeled in a shared legend at the top. In the left pie chart, the slices are Atomic Skill Fail (dark teal) at 68.0%, Correct (medium teal) at 12.0%, Reason Error (light blue-gray) at 12.0%, and Question Misunderstood (very light gray/white) at 8.0%, with percentage labels shown inside each slice. In the right pie chart, the slices are Correct (medium teal) at 55.0%, Reason Error (light blue-gray) at 21.0%, Question Misunderstood (very light gray/white) at 14.0%, and Atomic Skill Fail (dark teal) at 10.0%, again with percentage labels inside the slices. Both charts include a legend, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segment arrangement appears to follow the slice placement around the circle rather than a clearly indicated sorted order.
